function.name: service_api_ServiceApi_create_service

function.name: team_api_TeamApi_create_team
function.description: Creates a new team in the system and generates an associated API key for team operations. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the new team to be created.

team_owner_email.description: The email address of the team's owner.

team_description.description: A brief description of the team and its purpose.

function.name: project_api_ProjectApi_create_project
function.description: Creates a new project within the system. If the project is a subproject, the UUID of the parent project must be provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The name of the new project.

description.description: A brief description of the project.

parent_project_uuid.description: The UUID of the parent project if this is a subproject, otherwise it can be omitted.

start_date.description: The start date for the project in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-01-01'.

end_date.description: The anticipated end date for the project in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'.

status.description: The current status of the project.

function.name: service_api_ServiceApi_get_all_services
function.description: This function retrieves a list of all services associated with a specific project identified by a universally unique identifier (UUID). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

uuid.description: The unique identifier for the project in the format of a UUID string (e.g., '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000').

function.name: team_api_TeamApi_delete_api_key
function.description: This function deletes a specified API key from the team's account, removing its access to the API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

apikey.description: The unique identifier for the API key that needs to be deleted.
